configurePresets.name: desktop-debug
configurePresets.description: Native build. gfx::renderer plus gfx::gles2, so the skratch demo builds. Day-to-day development.

configurePresets.name: desktop-software
configurePresets.description: Native build with WREEL_TARGET_HAS_GPU=OFF, so SDL is built without GL and gfx::renderer gets its software driver. This is how you test the Miyoo Mini code path without a device.

configurePresets.name: steam
configurePresets.description: Run this INSIDE the steamrt/sniper/sdk container. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

configurePresets.name: miyoomini
configurePresets.displayName: Miyoo Mini / Mini Plus (SSD202D, no GPU)
configurePresets.description: Run inside union-miyoomini-toolchain, or set MIYOOMINI_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT. GCC 8.3; no GPU, so gfx::renderer with the software driver is the only path.
